annotation.authors_or_issuer: 商务部 等9部门 (Ministry of Commerce and eight other departments)
key_provisions_or_claims: Support brand domestic service enterprises and innovative insurance products covering injury and liability risks
Strengthen social security for flexible-employment domestic workers
Build credit information verification platforms for domestic service workers
Revise the model Domestic Service Contract to cover privacy and commercial use of smart devices
Develop standards for digitalisation, in-home service risk management and privacy protection
annotation.summary_en: Notice from China's Ministry of Commerce and eight other bodies issuing policy measures to promote high-quality development of the domestic services sector: support for enterprises, social security, skills training, credit information platforms, model contracts and standards. Smart-device commercial use appears only as a contract topic; no AI or robot governance.
annotation.title_clean: 商务部等9部门关于印发《关于促进家政服务业高质量发展的若干政策措施》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the Ministry of Commerce and Eight Other Departments on Issuing Several Policy Measures to Promote High-Quality Development of the Domestic Services Industry
